title: Strangler Fig Pattern: Gradual Legacy Replacement via Routing
titleEs: Patrón Strangler Fig: reemplazo gradual de legacy mediante routing
description: Strangler Fig pattern examples: Nginx routing config, a Flask feature-flag router, Spring Cloud Gateway route definitions, a shadow traffic comparer in Python, a cutover progress tracker, branch by abstraction, and a parallel run comparator.
descriptionEs: Ejemplos del patrón Strangler Fig: configuración de routing con Nginx, router con feature flags en Flask, rutas de Spring Cloud Gateway, comparador de shadow traffic en Python, tracker de progreso de cutover, branch by abstraction y comparador de parallel run.
author: Mathias Paulenko
